mapper.sql: p.procurement_id poId, p.procurement_id procurementId, p.item_id itemId, i.item_code itemCode, i.item_name itemName, p.selected_vendor_id vendorId, v.vendor_name vendorName, p.order_qty orderQty, p.required_date procurementDue, COALESCE(p.unit_price, q.unit_price, 0) supplyPrice, p.status poStatus, p.received_qty acceptedQty, CASE WHEN p.status = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END isClosed
mapper.select: SELECT , CASE WHEN p.status IN ('STATEMENT_ISSUED','CLOSED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END statementCount FROM procurement p JOIN item i ON i.item_id = p.item_id LEFT JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.selected_vendor_id LEFT JOIN vendor_quote q ON q.quote_id = ( SELECT MAX(vq.quote_id) FROM vendor_quote vq WHERE vq.procurement_id = p.procurement_id AND (p.selected_vendor_id IS NULL OR vq.vendor_id = p.selected_vendor_id) ) ORDER BY p.procurement_id DESC

SELECT p.procurement_id shipmentId, , p.order_qty shipmentQty, p.status makeStatus, CASE WHEN p.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND p.shipped_at <= p.required_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END onTimeFlag, p.shipped_at shippedAt, p.required_date expectedArrivalDate, COALESCE(p.received_qty,0) previousAcceptedQty, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN sm.movement_type='IN' THEN sm.quantity ELSE -sm.quantity END) FROM stock_movement sm WHERE sm.item_id=p.item_id),0) currentAvailableQty, p.terms agreedTerms FROM procurement p JOIN item i ON i.item_id = p.item_id LEFT JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.selected_vendor_id LEFT JOIN vendor_quote q ON q.quote_id = ( SELECT MAX(vq.quote_id) FROM vendor_quote vq WHERE vq.procurement_id=p.procurement_id ) WHERE p.status = 'SHIPPED' AND COALESCE(p.received_qty,0) = 0 ORDER BY p.required_date, p.procurement_id

SELECT p.procurement_id receivingId, p.procurement_id shipmentId, p.procurement_id poId, p.item_id itemId, i.item_code itemCode, i.item_name itemName, v.vendor_name vendorName, p.inspection_result result, COALESCE(p.received_qty,0) receivedQty, CASE WHEN p.inspection_result IN ('ACCEPTED','PARTIAL') THEN COALESCE(p.received_qty,0) ELSE 0 END acceptedQty, CASE WHEN p.inspection_result='REJECTED' THEN COALESCE(p.order_qty,0) WHEN p.inspection_result='PARTIAL' THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(p.order_qty,0)-COALESCE(p.received_qty,0),0) ELSE 0 END rejectedQty, CASE WHEN p.inspection_result IN ('REJECTED','PARTIAL') THEN p.terms END rejectionReason, p.received_at inspectedAt, CASE WHEN p.status IN ('STATEMENT_ISSUED','CLOSED') THEN p.procurement_id END statementId, CASE WHEN p.status IN ('RETURN_REQUESTED','RESUPPLYING') THEN p.procurement_id END returnId, p.status returnStatus, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN sm.movement_type='IN' THEN sm.quantity ELSE -sm.quantity END) FROM stock_movement sm WHERE sm.item_id=p.item_id),0) availableQty FROM procurement p JOIN item i ON i.item_id = p.item_id LEFT JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.selected_vendor_id WHERE p.inspection_result IS NOT NULL OR p.received_at IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(p.received_qty,0) > 0 ORDER BY p.received_at DESC, p.procurement_id DESC

SELECT p.procurement_id returnId, p.procurement_id receivingId, p.selected_vendor_id vendorId, v.vendor_name vendorName, p.item_id itemId, i.item_code itemCode, i.item_name itemName, GREATEST(COALESCE(p.order_qty,0)-COALESCE(p.received_qty,0),0) returnQty, COALESCE(p.terms,'검수 불합격') returnReason, p.status, p.received_at requestedAt, CASE WHEN p.status='RETURN_COMPLETED' THEN p.updated_at END completedAt FROM procurement p JOIN item i ON i.item_id=p.item_id LEFT JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id=p.selected_vendor_id WHERE p.inspection_result IN ('RETURNED','REJECTED','PARTIAL') OR p.status IN ('RETURNED','RETURN_REQUESTED','RESUPPLYING','RETURN_COMPLETED') ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC, p.procurement_id DESC
SELECT item_id itemId, item_code itemCode, item_name itemName, spec, unit FROM item WHERE active = 1 AND item_type = 'MATERIAL' ORDER BY item_code

SELECT sm.movement_id movementId, sm.department_id departmentId, i.item_code itemCode, i.item_name itemName, i.unit, sm.movement_type movementType, sm.quantity, sm.reference_type referenceType, sm.reference_id referenceId, sm.memo, sm.processed_by processedBy, sm.created_at createdAt FROM stock_movement sm JOIN item i ON i.item_id = sm.item_id WHERE sm.movement_type=#{movementType} ORDER BY sm.created_at DESC, sm.movement_id DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT i.item_code itemCode, i.item_name itemName, 0 baseQty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sm.movement_type='IN' THEN sm.quantity ELSE -sm.quantity END),0) availableQty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sm.movement_type='IN' THEN sm.quantity ELSE -sm.quantity END),0) calcQty, COALESCE((SELECT vq.unit_price FROM vendor_quote vq JOIN procurement px ON px.procurement_id=vq.procurement_id WHERE px.item_id=i.item_id ORDER BY vq.created_at DESC LIMIT 1),0) unitPrice, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sm.movement_type='IN' THEN sm.quantity ELSE -sm.quantity END),0) * COALESCE((SELECT vq.unit_price FROM vendor_quote vq JOIN procurement px ON px.procurement_id=vq.procurement_id WHERE px.item_id=i.item_id ORDER BY vq.created_at DESC LIMIT 1),0) stockValue, MAX(sm.created_at) updatedAt, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sm.movement_type='OUT' THEN sm.quantity ELSE 0 END),0) periodIssueQty FROM item i LEFT JOIN stock_movement sm ON sm.item_id=i.item_id AND i.item_code=#{itemCode} GROUP BY i.item_id,i.item_code,i.item_name ORDER BY i.item_code

SELECT p.procurement_id statementId, p.procurement_id receivingId, p.procurement_id poId, p.selected_vendor_id vendorId, v.vendor_name vendorName, i.item_name itemName, p.received_qty qty, COALESCE(p.unit_price,q.unit_price,0) supplyPrice, CASE WHEN p.status='CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END isNotified, COALESCE(p.received_at,p.updated_at) createdAt FROM procurement p JOIN item i ON i.item_id=p.item_id LEFT JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id=p.selected_vendor_id LEFT JOIN vendor_quote q ON q.quote_id=(SELECT MAX(vq.quote_id) FROM vendor_quote vq WHERE vq.procurement_id=p.procurement_id) WHERE p.status IN ('RECEIVED','STATEMENT_ISSUED','CLOSED') ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC

SELECT p.procurement_id poId,i.item_name itemName,v.vendor_name vendorName, p.order_qty orderQty,p.received_qty acceptedQty,p.received_at completedAt FROM procurement p JOIN item i ON i.item_id=p.item_id LEFT JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id=p.selected_vendor_id WHERE p.status IN ('RECEIVED','STATEMENT_ISSUED') AND COALESCE(p.received_qty,0)>0 ORDER BY p.received_at DESC

SELECT p.procurement_id statementId,COALESCE(p.received_at,p.updated_at) createdAt, p.received_qty qty,COALESCE(p.unit_price,q.unit_price,0) supplyPrice, p.received_qty*COALESCE(p.unit_price,q.unit_price,0) totalPrice, CASE WHEN p.status='CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END isNotified, p.received_at inspectedAt,p.procurement_id poId,i.item_code itemCode,i.item_name itemName, v.vendor_id vendorId,v.vendor_name vendorName,'앙사모 ERP' orderCompanyInfo, v.vendor_name vendorInfo,COALESCE(p.terms,q.terms) agreedTerms FROM procurement p JOIN item i ON i.item_id=p.item_id LEFT JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id=p.selected_vendor_id LEFT JOIN vendor_quote q ON q.quote_id=(SELECT MAX(vq.quote_id) FROM vendor_quote vq WHERE vq.procurement_id=p.procurement_id) WHERE p.procurement_id=#{statementId}

SELECT p.procurement_id shipmentId,p.procurement_id poId,p.department_id departmentId,p.order_qty shipmentQty, p.item_id itemId,i.item_code itemCode,p.selected_vendor_id vendorId, p.status procurementStatus, COALESCE(p.unit_price,q.unit_price,0) supplyPrice, CASE WHEN p.received_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(p.received_qty,0)=0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END alreadyReceived FROM procurement p JOIN item i ON i.item_id=p.item_id LEFT JOIN vendor_quote q ON q.quote_id=(SELECT MAX(vq.quote_id) FROM vendor_quote vq WHERE vq.procurement_id=p.procurement_id) WHERE p.procurement_id=#{shipmentId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT mr.request_id issueId,mr.department_id departmentId,mr.item_id itemId,i.item_code itemCode, mr.request_qty releaseQty,COALESCE(mr.issued_qty,0) issueQty,mr.status, i.active, COALESCE((SELECT inv.current_qty FROM inventory inv WHERE inv.item_id=mr.item_id AND inv.department_id=mr.department_id),0) availableQty, COALESCE((SELECT vq.unit_price FROM vendor_quote vq JOIN procurement p ON p.procurement_id=vq.procurement_id WHERE p.item_id=mr.item_id ORDER BY vq.created_at DESC LIMIT 1),0) unitPrice FROM material_request mr JOIN item i ON i.item_id=mr.item_id WHERE mr.request_id=#{issueId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT inv.department_id departmentId, inv.item_id itemId, inv.current_qty currentQty, i.item_code itemCode, i.item_name itemName, i.active FROM inventory inv JOIN item i ON i.item_id = inv.item_id WHERE inv.department_id=#{departmentId} AND inv.item_id=#{itemId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory(department_id,item_id,current_qty,updated_at) SELECT #{departmentId},i.item_id,0,NOW() FROM item i WHERE i.item_id=#{itemId} AND i.active=1 AND i.item_type='MATERIAL' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at=updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory inv JOIN item i ON i.item_id=inv.item_id AND i.active=1 SET inv.current_qty=inv.current_qty+#{adjustmentQty}, inv.updated_at=NOW() WHERE inv.department_id=#{departmentId} AND inv.item_id=#{itemId} AND inv.current_qty+#{adjustmentQty} >= 0

UPDATE material_request SET status=#{status}, processed_by=#{userId}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE request_id=#{issueId} AND status IN
#{fromStatus}

UPDATE procurement SET received_qty=CASE WHEN #{result}='ACCEPTED' THEN #{acceptedQty} ELSE 0 END, received_at=CASE WHEN #{result}='ACCEPTED' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, inspection_result=#{result}, terms=CASE WHEN #{result}='RETURNED' THEN NULLIF(#{reason},'') ELSE terms END, status=CASE WHEN #{result}='ACCEPTED' THEN 'RECEIVED' ELSE 'RETURNED' END, updated_at=NOW() WHERE procurement_id=#{procurementId} AND status='SHIPPED'

UPDATE material_request SET issued_qty=#{qty}, status=#{status}, processed_by=#{userId}, issued_at=NOW(), updated_at=NOW() WHERE request_id=#{issueId} AND status='APPROVED' AND COALESCE(issued_qty,0)=0
UPDATE procurement SET status=#{status} WHERE procurement_id=#{returnId}
UPDATE procurement SET status='STATEMENT_ISSUED' WHERE procurement_id=#{procurementId} AND received_qty>0
UPDATE procurement SET status='CLOSED' WHERE procurement_id=#{statementId} AND status IN ('RECEIVED','STATEMENT_ISSUED')
UPDATE procurement SET status='CLOSED' WHERE procurement_id=#{poId} AND received_qty>0
